label: A cause of the received totality causes the esse of each received bearer
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise B, attribution deferred: on one fixed q3a4 profile, whatever is a cause of the esse of the totality of received actual bearers (TotalityCause, collective sense TOTALITY_CAUSE_1) is a cause, in the same esse respect (CausesIn, mode unspecified, not necessarily immediate), of the esse of each received actual bearer, including members it reaches only through intermediaries. A whole-to-members principle for this totality only; an analogue of the spacetime whole-to-parts bridge of #1109 in a different vocabulary, not identified with it. Under the distributive reading TOTALITY_CAUSE_2, B carries the whole joint claim and fails in the Hume-Edwards regress control. Principal rival: an internal loop or holistic whole whose totality cause is one of its own members.
